# First, identify the last two competitions based on the year (assuming chronological order by year)
# Sort by year to ensure correct ordering
df_sorted = df.sort_values('year')

# Get the last two rows (last two competitions)
last_two = df_sorted.tail(2)

# Extract the notes column which contains the distance as a string with ' m'
# Convert to numeric by removing the ' m' and converting to float
distances = last_two['notes'].str.replace(' m', '').astype(float)

# Calculate the average
average_distance = distances.mean()

# Check if the average is exactly 78.27 (using tolerance for floating point comparison)
answer = abs(average_distance - 78.27) < 1e-9
